caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped plate centered on a plain background. The plate features a subtle, transparent appearance with light shading indicating its form. Along the rim, there are decorative swirls in yellow at the top, bottom, and sides of the plate. On the left and right sections of the plate, detailed blue linework depicts scenes, likely pastoral or landscape elements, though the details are intricate and somewhat abstract. The inner area of the plate remains empty and unadorned. The image is rendered in a combination of gray, yellow, and blue hues, with the plate outlined in fine lines. The artist's signature, written in blue, is located in the bottom right corner outside the plate. The composition is framed within a faint rectangular pencil border that encloses the plate and its surrounding space.
title: Pie Dish
